newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian import prices fall 0.3 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian import prices fall 0.3 pct in July.

text.p: Australian import prices fell 0.3 percent in July from the previous month and stood 9.7 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
"The value of the Australian dollar rose slightly against all major currencies except the Japanese yen, leading to a small decrease in the index," the bureau said.
The bureau's import price index has fallen in every month since January.
The annual rate of import inflation has swung from 7.8 percent in June 1995 to minus 9.7 percent in July 1996.
